description: Acoli ka akiro ka Luo ŋina erworete itunga ŋulu ipu kotoma Gulu, Kitgum ka Pader, ka kotoma South Sudan.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Ateso courses (#131) with low confidence in Ateso; needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes about the target language.

why.title: Akiro ka **Gulu, Kitgum ka Acoli kere.**
why.text: Acoli erworete kotoma Gulu, Kitgum ka Pader, ka epoloi Alango, Alur ka Ajaluo ka Kenya. Kisisianakin kanuka ekal, elosit, aswam, ka isuban, ailip ka ailimor ka Acoli.

cards.title: Kanuka ekal
cards.text: Kirwor ka ikapolok ka ikaitotak kotoma Gulu ka Kitgum.

cards.title: Kanuka ikalosak
cards.text: Kilosi kiŋaren Soroti tetere Lira, Gulu ka Kitgum.

cards.title: Kanuka ŋulu emina ajenun
cards.text: Kiriamu akiro ka Luo ŋina mam ejaasi ŋakekan ka ŋakiro.

landing.audience: Itunga ŋulu erworete Ateso ŋulu ekiŋaren, ikalia ŋulu elomete Acoli, ka ikalosak ŋulu elosete Gulu.
landing.first: Ayakuno, aitodiaar ka ikarin, kau ekal, akimuj, ekeya, apak, ŋiboro, etogo ka ajokus ka akwaŋan, aitodolet ka aitodolet.

cast.emma: Ekaitoŋaon ŋesi esisianakini Acoli kiŋaren elosit
